after.description: DeclareFunction and CreateFunction bodies are lowered through the deferred IR3 path, where HostCalls are emitted directly without the IR2 flow annotation and IFC runtime guard seam used by top-level ops. Secret-bearing nested callbacks or functions can therefore bypass direct-operand egress enforcement. Route nested bodies through equivalent operand-aware flow analysis and guard insertion, with Secret earlier arg and Public last arg adversarial tests plus artifact correspondence.
